newsitem.title: USA: Stone Energy to buy interest in offshore field.
newsitem.headline: Stone Energy to buy interest in offshore field.

text.p: Stone Energy Corp said on Tuesday it agreed to acquire certain interests in an offshore Gulf of Mexico field for a price ranging from $30 million to $40 million, depending upon adjustments.

Stone said in a news release that there are eight platforms and 48 wells on the field, with 10 wells currently producing at aggregate daily rates of about 1,500 barrels of oil and 18 million cubic feet of natural gas.
Stone said it would finance the acquisition with bank borrowings from a group led by NationsBank. Closing was scheduled for August 1.
